steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each event is placed by the time it happened and when containment began.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Reporting obligation with no source
findings.fix: Name the rule the report is due under

outcome.notChecked: Whether the containment worked; the environmental effect.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] release-0411.md:12  Release with no containment time.
       Fix: Record when containment began.
[medium] emission-0412.md:19  Reporting obligation with no source.
       Fix: Name the rule the report is due under.
[medium] spill-0414.md:26  Action with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the containment worked; the environmental effect.
pros: Checks a release with no containment time, a reporting obligation with no source, and an action with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the containment worked; the environmental effect.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-environmental-incident skill on the records for this review.
